steps.prompt: If you had to explain how your favourite game works to someone who has never played it, what would you explain first?

cards.title: Explain one part
cards.body: An informative body paragraph explains one part of the topic named in the thesis. No side to take: use facts, examples and explanations, and keep opinions out.

cards.title: An informative body
cards.text: Honeybees also make honey, which farmers can sell. A strong hive can make more than 25 kilograms of honey in one year. This means a few hives can add real money to a small farm’s income.
cards.note: Topic sentence (the second part of the thesis) → fact → explanation.

cards.title: Check the parts
cards.body: Does every sentence belong to this paragraph’s part? A fact about a different part belongs in a different paragraph.

prompts: How did you keep your paragraph explaining instead of arguing?
Which fact best explained the part?
